verification_report.summary: The lemma, theorem, and corollary were verified sequentially. The upper-envelope comparison argument is valid on the rig-smooth interior and extends across the relative boundary; perfected base change, reduction, normalization, pullback, and finite-surjective descent are applied with their stated hypotheses; and the locally Fubini--Study, semipositive real-PL, and empty-family cases are handled correctly. All cited results were matched to their source and are applicable. No critical errors or gaps were found.
